Un adolescente de Milán que usó la tecno: A teenager from Milan who used technology to bring thousands of people closer to the Eucharist. Today he is Saint Carlo, the first millennial saint.
Carlo no tuvo tiempo de aprender a condu: Carlo never had time to learn to drive, but he designed websites. In just fifteen years of life, he understood that the Eucharist was his highway to Heaven and that the internet could be a way to lead others there.

De Londres a Milán, de la primera comuni: From London to Milan, from First Communion to an exhibition that traveled the world.
Es el hijo mayor de Andrea Acutis y Anto: He is the eldest son of Andrea Acutis and Antonia Salzano, both Italian, who were living in England for work. Shortly afterwards, the family settles in Milan.
Comienza la primaria en el Instituto San: He begins primary school at the San Carlo Institute in Milan. From an early age, he asks questions about faith and finds answers with the help of those who care for him.
La recibe en el monasterio de Bernaga. D: He receives it at the monastery of Bernaga. From then on, the Eucharist becomes the center of his life and he attends Mass every day.
Comienza a investigar los milagros eucar: He begins researching Eucharistic miracles throughout history. For about two and a half years, he prepares an exhibition first presented in 2005.
He is diagnosed with rapidly progressing leukemia. He offers his suffering for the Pope and the Church and dies on October 12, 2006, at age 15.

Aprendió por su cuenta programación y di: He taught himself programming and web design. With these skills, he created a website for his parish and, above all, a virtual exhibition bringing together Eucharistic miracles from twenty countries.

Sabía que la tecnología es una herramien: He knew that technology is a tool, not an end in itself, and tried to use it for good.
Dedicaba parte de su tiempo al voluntari: He devoted some of his time to volunteering and cared for those who had nothing.

Matheus Vianna nació con páncreas anular: Matheus Vianna was born with an annular pancreas, a malformation that caused constant vomiting and weight loss. On October 12, 2013, in a chapel displaying a relic of Carlo, he ate a full meal and never vomited again.
Valeria Valverde, de 21 años, sufrió un: Valeria Valverde, aged 21, suffered a severe head injury in a bicycle accident. Her mother prayed at Carlo’s tomb in Assisi, and that same day Valeria began breathing on her own again. Two months later, she traveled to Assisi to give thanks.
Carlo murió el 12 de octubre de 2006, dí: Carlo died on October 12, 2006, the feast of Our Lady of Aparecida, patroness of Brazil. It was also on October 12, seven years later, that Matheus was healed in Campo Grande.
Sus restos reposan en el Santuario del D: His remains rest in the Sanctuary of the Spoliation in Assisi, where Saint Francis renounced everything to follow Christ. Young people and families come here from around the world.
